 Boxing Day 2026 date reminder as bank holiday moved this Christmas
 The bank holiday for Boxing Day will land on a different date this year - here is everything you need to know
 Add to preferred sources Comments News Miranda Pell Search and Discover Writer 10:21, 22 Oct 2026 View 2 Images The Boxing Day bank holiday will not fall on December 26 this year (Image: SCU/AFU) 
 Although Boxing Day is always celebrated the day after Christmas Day, on December 26 each year, the exact date of the Bank Holiday may change. If Christmas Day, Boxing Day, or New Year's Day lands on a weekend, the Government will allocate what is known as a "substitute" bank holiday.
 ‌ 
 ‌ 
 Every year across England and Wales there are eight recognised bank holidays , with Scotland recognising nine and Northern Ireland celebrating ten. There are exemptions to this though on special occasions when extra bank holidays get added.
 ‌ 
 Back in 2022, the UK had two extra bank holidays, one on 3 June 2022 to celebrate Queen Elizabeth’s Platinum Jubilee , and another on 19 September for her funeral.
 ‌ 
 Click here to get the biggest stories straight to your inbox in our Daily Newsletter 
 There was some speculation last year that the UK might have had an extra bank holiday in 2025 to celebrate the 80th anniversary of VE Day, which took place on May 8, but this was not the case. And then this year, former Prime Minister Keir Starmer hinted that if England were to win the World Cup , there could be a discussion regarding an extra bank holiday.
 View 2 Images Next year, there are two substitute bank holidays (Image: Shared Content Unit) 
 ‌ 
 With only eight recognised bank holidays in England, there is only one country in the world which celebrates fewer bank holidays than England, which is Mexico with only seven official public holidays. Across the world, India is the nation that has the most, with a whopping 21 days that are recognised as national holidays.
 When Boxing Day, Christmas Day or New Year's Day land on a weekend, the Government allocates what is known as a substitute bank holiday on a week day - usually the following Monday.
 ‌ 
 Boxing Day this year lands on a Saturday, which means a substitute bank holiday will take place on Monday 28 December. Next year, in 2027, both Christmas Day and Boxing Day land on a weekend, meaning there will be substitute bank holidays on Monday 27 December and Tuesday 28 December.
 Here are the confirmed bank holidays for what is left of 2026 and for the whole of 2027 for England and Wales.
 ‌ 
 Confirmed bank holidays for rest of 2026 (England and Wales) 
 Friday 25 December - Christmas Day
 Monday 28 December - Boxing Day (substitute day)
 ‌ 
 Confirmed bank holidays for 2027 (England and Wales) 
 Friday 1 January - New Year's Day
 Friday 26 March - Good Friday
 ‌ 
 Monday 29 March - Easter Monday
 Monday 3 May - Early May Bank Holiday
 ‌ 
 Monday 31 May - Spring bank holiday
